findings.title: Model router call log missing

findings.title: Direct LLM API invocation bypassing model router in emergency alert processing

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral bypassing the centralized model router endpoint

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM requests through the centralized model router on port 8891

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces centralized LLM rate limiting, fallback routing, logging, and token cost tracking
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review
